principles: Scripture is the highest authority for understanding creation.
Creation descriptions should be consistent with the biblical text.
Avoid assuming modern cosmological models as established fact.
Do not describe the heavens as infinite or endless.
Do not present heliocentrism as established fact. Instead, focus on the geocentric model and how it is backed by Scripture.
Use biblical language when discussing the heavens, firmament, sun, moon, and stars.
When discussing planets, acknowledge that historical and biblical perspectives as well as observed science may differ from modern classifications.
Creation should be presented from an observational and scriptural perspective.
